title: Unity Catalog native model-version registration: dependency types without a governance securable are dropped, not errors
answers: Why is my model's resource missing from the governance dependency list when registering a model to Unity Catalog natively?
Does a model service or model endpoint dependency show up in the UC native create-model-version request?
Which resource types become table, function, or connection securables in the native Unity Catalog registration path?
body:
Path: The native Unity Catalog model-version create path translates MLflow resource dependencies into the governance DependencyList on the native CreateModelVersion request. Only vector index and table map to a table securable, UC function to a function securable, and UC connection to a connection securable.
Rule: A dependency type has a governance representation only if the governance DependencyList has a securable for it. Types with none (DATABRICKS_MODEL_ENDPOINT, DATABRICKS_UC_MODEL_SERVICE, and any unknown kind) are silently dropped on this path, which is intentional. Do not add a governance securable for a new type just to make it appear here unless the governance API defines one; the legacy/proxy path still carries it via get_model_version_dependencies.
Symptom: A resource type that is recorded on the legacy path is absent from the native governance dependency list, which can look like a lost dependency.
Constraints: This applies only to the native (governance) path. Legacy/proxy registration still records these types. Covered by test_create_model_version_translates_dependencies_to_governance in tests/store/_unity_catalog/model_registry/test_unity_catalog_rest_store_native.py.
applies: Native Unity Catalog model-version registration (governance DependencyList) for model resource dependency types in MLflow.
says: Model service and endpoint dependencies do not show up in catalog governance lists.
Registered model versions appear to lose endpoint dependencies in native catalog lineage views.
Why are some linked model resources missing from governance dependency records after registration?
Show model endpoint and service connections under native catalog governance dependency views.
Certain model dependencies vanish from the governance tab when registering models natively.
